summary: Scoped security review of the two tested Rules corrections, now deployed with explicit user approval to trac-aidhunt and read back byte-for-byte. All 262 Rules tests passed. Existing timestamp trust and schema-limit risks remain; this is not a comprehensive security certification.

findings.issue: The existing offline edit policy trusts the client's original action timestamp. An authorized client can backdate that claim; this patch does not introduce tamper-proof time authorization.
findings.recommendation: Keep this limitation explicit. Design any server-issued authorization or time-policy change separately, including offline usability and migration tests, before changing historical eligibility.

findings.issue: The changed envelope bounds dependency count, but the complete legacy ruleset does not impose comprehensive per-field length/type limits for all customer and business text fields.
findings.recommendation: Perform a separate compatibility-aware schema and resource-limit hardening review; do not add untested limits that reject existing customer records during this repair.

reviewedControls: Membership comes from workspace member paths, not user profile role claims.
Absent redundant membership workspaceId falls back to the authoritative path; explicitly foreign metadata is denied.
Positive IDs, active references, foreign workspace denial and inactive member denial remain tested.
Collection create/update and source balance changes remain atomic and subject to collector authorization.
Membership escalation, foreign access, direct deletion bypasses and immutable provenance changes retain negative tests.
Only the tested Rules candidate was deployed, with user approval; customer records and live rejected operations were not mutated.
Stale customer snapshots are suppressed only by an exact server deletion-proof workspace, record ID and original creation-time match; reads occur outside the Room transaction.

resolvedFindings.issue: The legacy collector membership-field requirement and the repeated reference evaluation defect are corrected in the live deployed candidate.
resolvedFindings.recommendation: Preserve role, membership, workspace and atomic-collection safeguards; review retained live operations individually before recovery.
